# Mission — Olam Media + Prompt Body

User intent: make the Olam H3 UI/UX dramatically easier, especially adding images and writing the prompt that tells H3 what to make.

Primary desired flow:
1. Add one or more images.
2. See those images immediately in the main body.
3. Write the instruction/prompt directly with them.
4. Let the app infer or expose the relevant media mode clearly.
5. Generate without hunting through distant panels.

Existing behavior must survive: reusable assets, frame/reference semantics, image replacement/removal, mode state, provider readiness, prompt templates, MiniMax payload contracts, mobile performance, reduced motion, and history/persistence.

This mission is incomplete until implementation, media-update proof, API/browser regressions, push, exact deployment, public proof, and cleanup all close.
